I can’t give an exact value from a blurry chart. If axis labels, tick numbers, or the underlying data aren’t readable or provided, I mustn’t invent a precise number — chart‑accuracy rules require either visible numeric labels or the source data.

What I can do next (pick one):
- You upload the original/clearer image or the chart’s source data (CSV / spreadsheet). I’ll read the exact value.  
- I can try to enhance the image and produce an approximate value with an uncertainty range (e.g., “about X ± Y”), and I’ll state how confident that estimate is. This won’t be exact.  
- I can show you how to estimate it yourself from the image (quick method: measure bar height in pixels vs. axis pixel span and convert using visible tick values or gridlines).

Which would you like me to do? If you want an estimate now, please attach the image (or confirm you want me to attempt enhancement and estimation).
